steps: Consume no authority from this plan alone. First validate the exact owner approval and the clean reviewed task commit/digest. Preserve all existing stopped worker/delegation/scope-v2 settings. Do not merge, push, restart, or enable any service.

Verify the runtime skill equals runtime-baseline.json and that the two new script/connection targets are absent. Stop on drift. Save the existing skill and an absence manifest under the declared private backup directory; do not overwrite a prior backup.

Using the existing claude-code skill's supported management functions, install byte-identical history.py as scripts/claude_history.py and connection.main.json as references/main-connection.json. Insert the exact skill-entry.md fragment immediately before the existing PTY Dialog Handling section. Leave every other skill section and profile unchanged.

Verify installed file digests and load claude-code through skill_view. Invoke the installed CLI for actual Mac list/search/read, verify source identity and search-to-read correspondence, and compare transcript SHA256/mtime before and after. Save only sanitized counts and digests to the existing task. If verification fails, execute rollback and leave the overall request incomplete.

Record the verified installed digest on the existing card only after real installed-entry E2E succeeds. This authorizes no Claude inference, key/SSH/LaunchAgent changes, billing, new agent/worker dispatch, raw transcript persistence, or other runtime changes.
rollback: Stop using the new reader; it has no daemon or hook to stop. Remove only the two newly installed task-owned files if their digests still match the approved installation and the backup manifest proves they did not exist before.
Restore only the saved claude-code SKILL.md if the current skill still equals the installed generation; otherwise stop for drift rather than overwrite concurrent edits. Keep the backup evidence.
Verify the pre-install skill digest and original absence of the two new entry files. Mac history, SSH keys, the existing reverse tunnel, gateway, other profiles, and stopped systems remain untouched.
